arcs.title: Arc I: The Burden of Legacy

payload.text: You return from the black void, the weight of Lyra's revelations pressing down on you. The Yendaverse is not what it seems—it's a 'rebuild,' a pale copy of a world that was destroyed. As Lyra speaks, Ilyrisis feels a cold dread, connecting the trauma of the gods to the ghosts of his own past.
Your investigation leads you to a derelict lab, home to 'Project Chimera.' Alarms blare as you access the mainframe. Automated defenses are activating!

payload.description: A grotesque fusion of metal and flesh awakens—a failed attempt to replicate divine consciousness. It mirrors the monster Ilyrisis could have become.
